entries.contract: Node, Metro, Expo autolinking and Gradle must resolve the audited worktree, never another workspace.
Startup must render a diagnosable recovery surface for configuration, storage, auth or navigation failure instead of an unbounded blank gate.
blockers: Current implementation still requires instrumentation and physical cold-start closure.

entries.contract: The active destination and bottom navigation form one Android view tree.
blockers: Full route implementation inventory and physical-device closure remain open.

entries.contract: Use the real TabPageWidget to TabBottomBar chain as authority; NavBottomTabBar is only a More-page negative reference.
blockers: Current implementation has not been structurally closed by the full UAST and View-tree gates.

entries.contract: Re-selecting the active Schedule tab dispatches the page action that returns Calendar to today.
blockers: MainTabs currently only writes the already-selected state.

entries.contract: Common title bars use source-derived heights, typography, action ownership and save states.
blockers: All reachable title bars are not yet mapped and tokenized.

entries.contract: A separate 50dp band contains one trailing mode control for the retained month/day modes.
The 48dp create FAB preserves source shadow and short-press motion while adding the approved long-press voice/manual arc.
blockers: Source S4 shadow and short-press two-stage motion are missing.

entries.contract: Temporary pages, sheets, dialogs and toasts have one Activity/window owner.
blockers: Profile sheet, Minutes title dialog and undo banner still bypass the unified owner.

entries.contract: The dim layer and sheet motion have independent ownership and timing.
blockers: Current entry alpha animates the whole host, coupling the mask to the sheet.

entries.contract: LaoJi uses one Activity-owned latest-wins text toast while retaining source geometry, timing and lifecycle.
blockers: Full reachable-route mapping remains open.

entries.contract: Loading, empty, error and retry states use source-derived state ownership and dimensions.
blockers: App initialization still has a null/blank state rather than a bounded recovery state.

entries.contract: Color, type, divider, radius, shadow and spacing tokens derive from locked resources.
blockers: NativeUiTokens, CalendarUi and page-local constants still disagree; dark branches remain in a light-only release.

entries.contract: Product chrome uses packaged stable icons rather than OEM-dependent android.R drawables.
blockers: Minutes title actions and FAB still use android.R.drawable resources.

entries.contract: All account and legal pages use source-derived containers while retaining LaoJi business content.
blockers: Nine reachable RN pages remain unmapped by the TS AST evidence gate.

entries.contract: Sixteen unique Root route names and two MainTabs destinations have explicit owners, transitions and recovery behavior.
blockers: Full source-derived route contracts and final physical-device closure remain open.

entries.contract: Android production routes contain no legacy LaoJi presentation owners or hidden duplicate controls.
blockers: Thirty-one platform-shadowed or orphaned TSX presentation files still exist and 208 controls are unmapped.

entries.contract: Calendar shell retains month and single-day branches from the source mode router.
blockers: Complete implementation evidence mapping remains open.

entries.contract: Left, center and right pages settle by exactly minus one, zero or plus one month.
blockers: Full gesture and restoration proof is not yet bound to this inventory entry.

entries.contract: Date expansion follows Open, Close and OpenAfterClosed across same-row, cross-row and cross-month selection.
blockers: Cross-row, cross-month and animation-keyframe closure remains open.

entries.contract: Snapshot rebind preserves the selected-date expansion and active transition.
Cross-day events are clipped to a week and rendered as one continuous span per occupied row.
blockers: View-tree and geometry evidence are not yet closed.

entries.contract: Date header, all-day region, timeline, event layer and gesture owner retain separate native ownership.
blockers: Full View-tree structure and synchronized pager motion remain open.

entries.contract: The visible day ruler has 25 whole-hour lines from 00:00 through 24:00; default duration and snap precision are separate contracts.
blockers: No standalone evidence implementation and test mapping exists yet.

entries.contract: All-day content folds to three rows, expands with bounded height and preserves horizontal pager ownership.
blockers: Adjacent-page height and process restoration evidence remain open.

entries.contract: One event-area gesture owner arbitrates create, move and resize interactions.
blockers: Ownership and cancellation are not yet closed by instrumentation evidence.

entries.contract: Top and bottom handles resize start and end; body drag moves the whole event using the source 15/30-minute rules.
blockers: dragPrecisionMinutes is currently a dead prop and the implementation hardcodes 15 minutes.

entries.contract: Ruler, month expansion, search, detail and edit use one system 12/24-hour format contract.
blockers: Month expansion and snapshot paths still force HH:mm.

entries.contract: QuickChoose retains closing, opening, closed and opened states plus date/year-month transitions.
blockers: Complete animation and restoration evidence remains open.

entries.contract: Tapping any visible wheel row settles and commits that value.
Search input, results, empty state, event open and in/out transitions form one route closure.
blockers: The source animation bodies are absent; exact motion must remain unverified or use approved runtime evidence.

entries.contract: Detail and edit retain source page structure while deleting unsupported participant, room and meeting linkage regions.
blockers: Current pages remain simplified and are not fully source-mapped.

entries.contract: Repeat editing exposes interval, weekdays and end condition supported by the LaoJi event model.
blockers: The UI currently exposes only coarse repeat presets.

entries.contract: Calendar dimensions, colors, strings and motion resources are locked and mapped to Android resources.
blockers: CalendarUi and CalendarPageUi still contain broad hardcoded constants.

entries.contract: Minutes list, search, recording and detail routes originate from one retained LaoJi destination.
blockers: Complete implementation and View-tree evidence mapping remains open.

entries.contract: List search and transcript/detail search remain distinct source-derived workflows.

entries.contract: The Record V3 title, subtitle, waveform and operation regions follow the active VC host branch.
blockers: The active Feishu feature-gate branch and full LaoJi View-tree comparison are not yet closed.

entries.contract: LaoJi maps start, pause, resume, stop, local save, upload and failure to its AudioRecord service without claiming Feishu state-enum parity.

entries.contract: Recording waveform geometry and interpolation remain native and source-derived.

entries.contract: Partial and final transcript rows update without replacing prior completed speech.

entries.contract: WorkManager owns constrained unique upload and exponential retry.
blockers: Kill-process and credential-lease fault matrix is not fully closed.

entries.contract: Detail pages are built from actual LaoJi capabilities; no fixed-three-tab Feishu claim is allowed.
blockers: Generation, recreation, tab-race and independent-scroll closure remain open.

entries.contract: Measured header collapse precedes page scroll; downward expansion occurs only when the active page is at top.
blockers: Non-touch inertia and production-player composition remain open.

entries.contract: Media3 provides source-equivalent play, pause, seek, speed, focus and background-service semantics.

entries.contract: Source, position, speed and the approved playing/paused recovery policy are explicit and encrypted.

entries.contract: Voiceprint list, enrollment, consent, retry and deletion expose only real LaoJi service capabilities.
